text_block_list.name: Enemy Knight Commander
text_block_list.text:
Behold the proud elites of my chivalric order!
Your fate is sealed here and now! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...A tight spot is my greatest opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I have been waiting for this moment.
At this distance...
I can cut down everything with a single strike."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Like lightning cleaving through the heavens—
Flash forth, Orage's Flash!

text_block_list.name: Enemy Knight Commander
text_block_list.text:
Im... possible...
With just a single strike...! Gwah...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My blade is the 'Holy Sword'—
Know that its sharpness is second to none.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how did you like it?
...This story written by a fan!
It seems a fan wrote a novel starring her and sent it over. Apparently, it was inspired by the races Durandal ran in.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: As if cutting down a massive army with a single stroke, she flashes past her rivals with her closing burst!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: They said that seeing her like that, reminiscent of a master swordsman who had perfected their craft, inspired the story.
choice_data_list: Your finishing kick is your greatest weapon, after all
Your finishing kick is your greatest weapon, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely.
This very sharpness is why it is called the 'Holy Sword.'

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I shall sharpen my blade even further...
and show you its overwhelming, peerless edge.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Because that must be the knightly figure of Durandal that all the fans wish to see."
choice_data_list: Still, who would've thought they'd turn it into a story?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, hearing that I'm like a real knight
...fufu.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If my image is that of a seasoned knight,
I shall strive never to betray those expectations!
